gen-gf-warnes-gf-winky-sans: Expressive and a bit showy, Warnes stretches its ink-drawn letters wide apart. Winky Sans keeps its capitals barely taller than lowercase, sitting low and quiet under those ring-like, constant-walled shapes.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-yantramanav: Stretched out and ink-bold, Warnes draws every curve without a hint of thinning. And Yantramanav's huddled, tall-lowercase sans-serif is the counterweight, tight and compact where Warnes is stretched and loose.
gen-gf-warnes-outfit: Outfit is a friendly sans with a moderate lowercase height. Warnes towers over it with a higher lowercase and stretched spacing, its tapered ink strokes giving the lines a bold, drawn-out presence.
gen-gf-warnes-plus-jakarta-sans: Loud, stretched, and ink-drawn: Warnes announces itself with strokes that taper out before touching. Plus Jakarta Sans then takes over as a monoline sans-serif, precise and modern, its curve endings kept well apart.
gen-gf-warnes-sora: Warnes stretches its tapered ink strokes wide, with a taller lowercase and no stroke contrast at all, loud and expressive. Sora, a precise geometric sans, sits lower and keeps its curves open.
gen-gf-warnes-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk reads geometric and plain, with counters that breathe. Warnes is best at shouting, with wide spacing and bold tapered ink strokes, while the sans is best at holding steady, one ribbon of constant width.
gen-irish-grover-fs-amulya: Amulya is a contemporary sans-serif whose curves keep generous gaps, moderate in lowercase height. And across paragraph after paragraph it keeps reading modern and unfussy, never crowding the sturdy, nib-soft Irish Grover above.
gen-irish-grover-fs-chillax: Chillax reads loose and relaxed, like spaghetti laid out in letters. Down a whole page it stays casual and easygoing, its pen-lifted curves left unfinished, a loose counterpart to the sturdy, tall lowercase of Irish Grover.
gen-irish-grover-fs-plein: Plein is reliable and clean, with a clear channel leading into each round letter it draws. Long stretches of it read smoothly, a quiet foil for Irish Grover.
gen-irish-grover-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans is contemporary and approachable, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. And its moderate lowercase against the tall, sturdy one in Irish Grover is the sharpest difference, a quiet sans beside a fun, organic heading.
